updates.title: Speaker System optimizations
changes: Car tablets show a still screen to people outside the car, so nearby PCs stop drawing them. The music sounds the same.
Setting: Live Screens Outside the Car.

updates.title: Works on qs-inventory and more
changes: Speaker items now work on qs-inventory and every other inventory gg_lib supports.

updates.title: Linked volume, yPhone and emoji fixes
changes: Linked speakers turn up and down together, the app stays on yPhone after a restart and emoji song titles save.
Car tablets are much lighter on FPS.

updates.title: Shop works on any game build
changes: The shop's computer desk, TV stand and coffee table now ship with the props, so the shop works on game build 3095 and newer.

updates.title: QBCore speaker pick-up fix
changes: Fixed an oversight on QBCore where a picked-up speaker dropped back to the ground a second later.
It now stays in hand until you set it down or put it away.

updates.title: Speaker System is here
changes: Speakers, stereos, beam and strobe lights and car dash tablets with a subwoofer, all played from the Speaker Connect phone app.
